title: Place
explanation:
En says in, on, or at: el libro está en la mesa. A says toward: voy a la estación. A plus el becomes al, and de plus el becomes del.

Cerca de means near. La casa está cerca del parque uses del because de and el combine.
commonMistake: Saying en el when you mean toward, or leaving a el and de el uncontracted.

examples.spanish: El libro está en la mesa.
examples.english: The book is on the table.
I am going to the station.
I am going to the bank.
We are going to the museum.

examples.spanish: La casa está cerca del parque.
examples.english: The house is near the park.

examples.spanish: El café está en la mesa.
examples.english: The coffee is on the table.
